newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland cuts December T-bill offer to PLN 3.95 bln.
newsitem.headline: Poland cuts December T-bill offer to PLN 3.95 bln.

text.p: The Polish finance ministry cut its monthly T-bill offer for December to 3.95 billion zlotys from 4.6 billion in November and will not offer 8-week and 39-week bills next month, it said in a statement.
Auctions are sheduled for December 2, 9, 16 and 30.
There will be no auction on December 23, 1996 but the treasury said it may hold an auction on December 19, with the value date on December 23, depending on budget financing needs.
